info.title: SyncSession.Tools
info.description: CLI tools for migrating existing MySQL/MariaDB databases to SyncSession. Provides assess, clone, migrate, and validate commands.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: SyncSystem migration tools — assess, clone, migrate, validate

commands.name: assess
commands.description: Assess an existing database and entity assembly for SyncSystem migration readiness

options.name: --assembly
options.description: Path to the .dll containing ISyncEntity classes

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Output directory for the report file

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print raw entity scan results before DB cross-reference

commands.name: clone
commands.description: Generate a CREATE DATABASE + CREATE TABLE SQL script (clone mode migration)

options.name: --assembly
options.description: Path to the .dll containing ISyncEntity classes

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Output directory for generated SQL script

commands.name: migrate
commands.description: Generate ALTER TABLE (server/MySQL) and/or CREATE TABLE (client/SQLite) SQL scripts

options.name: --assembly
options.description: Path to the .dll containing ISyncEntity classes

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Output directory for generated SQL scripts

options.name: --target
options.description: Migration target: server (MySQL ALTER), client (SQLite CREATE), or both

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate a migrated database is fully SyncSystem-ready

options.name: --assembly
options.description: Path to the .dll containing ISyncEntity classes

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Output directory for the validation report
